comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
New aide from Chapter 3, from Rescue NPC that can be recruited. Once you saved him, you can recruit him in Venice.

Aide Skill (Aide Level req):
Detour (11/5/5)
Cargo Organization (8/10/4)
Entertainment (2/4/5)
Arbitration (0/8/6)
Casting Task (0/20/5)
Crafts Task (5/24/5)
Obstruction (13/13/20)
Italian (0/0/0)

Support Skill (Aide Level req):
Wining and Dining +1 (10/3/0)
Accounts +1 (0/16/0)
Wares trading +1 (2/10/2)
Casting +1 (0/30/5)
Frugality +1 (5/10/0)
Handicrafts +1 (0/23/0)
Lookout +1 (0/0/2)

He is copycat of old aide Urbain but skill requirements seems lowered.

comments.author: Ging
comments.body: Found this guy in Alexander Archipelago Open Sea. Can be hired in Venice.

comments.author: Bael
comments.body: This guy can be found everywhere

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: As Bael said, this particular aide can be found anywhere in the world that Rescue NPCs spawn (including those coordinates). If you're in a hurry, my best advice is to try the Balearic Islands, Open Sea zone -- it is the smallest sea that NPCs can spawn in, and you can tell immediately if any are present. Just sail between the ocean zones east/west or west/east until a Rescue icon appears. Hope you get the aide you want soon! Cheers.

comments.author: V_I
comments.body: FYI, this aide can be taught Sewing skill if you use Captain's Secret Notes or have the skill left behind by an aide sent to Royal Navy. Great if you need Casting/Handicrafts/Sewing on one aide for Quarters Production recipes!
